sources.full: Giant Sea Spider for Foundry VTT

entries: An original homebrew aquatic predator inspired by the classic Giant Spider, substantially strengthened for a more dangerous encounter. Its silk functions underwater as a homebrew adaptation. CR 5 is a starting estimate, not a claim of independent encounter-balance testing; underwater terrain, party level, and access to aquatic movement can significantly affect the encounter.

Pale chitin and eight barnacle-encrusted legs emerge from the silt. This predator anchors nearly invisible strands between submerged rocks and wreckage, sensing the movements of prey through the waterlogged silk.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Sense
entries: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with that web.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The spider can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If this poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is {@condition paralyzed} while poisoned in this way.

action.name: Web {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. {@h}The target is {@condition restrained} by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a {@dc 15} Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 12; hp 15; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage). This aquatic spider's silk remains functional underwater.
